results.ask: What's special about my block? I'm on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega.
results.expect: calls about_block; gives the block's own figures and something pinned nearby, with sources; cites
results.answer:
Your block sits about 39 feet above sea level, 0.2 miles from Ocean Beach. Most homes date to around 1941, though the city's rolls range from 1908 to 2004 ([SF Assessor-Recorder via DataSF](https://data.sf.gov/d/yhqp-riqs)).

- **Old photos:** Two photographs from the Western Neighborhoods Project are pinned about 250 feet north, at 46th and Moraga: [wnp58.929](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp58.929.jpg) and [wnp58.923](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp58.923.jpg) ([OpenSFHistory](https://opensfhistory.org)).
- **Wartime model homes:** Rainbow House (1941) and Freedom House (1942) stand about 950 feet east, at 43rd Ave. Sunset builders gave their models hopeful names as WWII approached ([Western Neighborhoods Project](https://www.outsidelands.org/doelger-types.php)).
- **Under the street:** Like every block here, you're on dune sand over older Colma and Merced layers ([USGS](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wri/1993/4019/report.pdf)).

Street sweeping: east side Mon 1st and 3rd, noon to 2pm (next: Nov 16). West side Thu 1st, 3rd, and 5th, noon to 2pm (next: Nov 19). This is from the [city schedule](https://data.sf.gov/d/yhqp-riqs); the signs on the block are the last word.

If you know your block's history, I'd like to add it to the notes.
